name: Djuphav
description: The deep sea: a sine with a quiet triangle an octave above it, the octave shift taking it down one more. Play a slow line under everything. Push the wheel to morph the triangle louder for a little more edge on small speakers.

name: Draug
description: A restless dead: two saws a little out of tune, beating slowly, through the distortion and a 24 dB low-pass that LFO 2 moves. Hold long notes at the bottom. Push the wheel to morph the beating faster and the filter open.

name: Fenris
description: The bound wolf: at rest a dark sub. Push the wheel to morph it loose: the cutoff and resonance rise, the pulse below growls into the saw by FM, and LFO 1 starts to wobble the filter in eighth notes, in time with the song. Play long notes at the bottom and ride the wheel.

name: Granit
description: Granite: four saws in unison on every key, an octave apart, spread wide through a 24 dB low-pass with a firm envelope. Play a line at the bottom. Strike harder to morph the envelope deeper; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Gruva
description: A mine: two pulses whose widths LFO 1 sweeps, through the notch and low-pass, which carves a hollow out of them. Play a line at the bottom. Push the wheel to morph the sweep quicker and the filter open.

name: Hammare
description: A hammer: a pulse and a saw an octave down. Soft notes are round and dark, hard ones bright and biting, the morph opening the cutoff, the envelope and the resonance with the strike. Play a line at the bottom and dig in; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Irrbloss
description: A will-o'-the-wisp: one saw through a 24 dB low-pass at the edge of whistling, its envelope following the strike, the distortion on, gliding only where notes overlap. Play a line at the bottom, slurring some notes. Strike harder to morph the filter brighter and the glide longer; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Kolsvart
description: Pitch black: oscillator 2 synced and swept down by the mod envelope at each note, through a 24 dB low-pass. Play a line at the bottom. Strike harder to morph the sweep wider; the wheel raises the synced oscillator for a growl.

name: Malm
description: Ore: a sine and its ring modulation with a narrow pulse an octave up, through a low-pass that snaps shut. Play a line at the bottom. Strike harder to morph the pulse narrower and the filter brighter; the wheel moves the pulse's pitch for clangorous bends.

name: Skridsko
description: A skate: a pulse with a saw an octave up, gliding wherever notes overlap, through a resonant low-pass. Play a line at the bottom, its notes touching. Strike harder to morph the glide longer; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Smide
description: Forged iron: a sine frequency-modulated by a triangle at its own pitch, the mod envelope striking a burst of FM at each note that the hammer leaves ringing. Play a line at the bottom. Strike harder to morph the burst brighter; the wheel adds FM.

name: Torv
description: Peat: a saw and a square an octave down, plucked through a 12 dB low-pass that closes fast, its envelope following the strike. Play a line at the bottom. Strike harder to morph it ringing longer; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Glasharmonika
description: A glass harmonica: a sine frequency-modulated six times up, swelling in, held with a gentle tremolo. Play slow chords. The wheel adds FM.

name: Isklocka
description: An ice bell: a sine ring-modulated by a triangle that ignores the keys, held at one pitch, so every key rings a different metal; LFO 1 wavers it. Strike notes across the keyboard. Push the wheel to morph the fixed partner higher.

name: Klang
description: A struck bell: a sine frequency-modulated by a square about three times up. Strike softly for a pure chime; strike hard to morph in a deep, metallic FM and more level. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Kyrkklocka
description: A church bell: a sine frequency-modulated at an inharmonic three and a half times its pitch, an octave down, the FM fading as it rings. Strike single notes and let them ring. Push the wheel to morph the strike harder and the ring longer.

name: Speldosa
description: A music box: a sine ring-modulated by a triangle two octaves up, an octave above the keys, short and sweet. Play a melody. Push the wheel to morph the ring louder.

name: Bronslur
description: A bronze lur that cuts: oscillator 2 synced, its pitch lifted and let fall by the mod envelope, in unison pairs through a swelling low-pass. Play chords. Strike harder to morph the sync's rise wider; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Fanfar
description: A fanfare stab: a saw and a pulse in unison pairs, a quick filter envelope. Play short chords on and off the beat. Strike harder to morph it brighter; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Lur
description: After the Bronze Age lurs: two saws whose filter swells open a moment after the note, as breath does. Play chords and press into them, which opens the filter further. Strike harder to morph a quicker, brighter blow; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Vallhorn
description: A herding horn: a saw with a triangle, a slow, soft swell of the filter and a little vibrato. Play chords or a slow line in the middle. Push the wheel to morph it: blow harder, brighter and quicker.

name: Blixtnedslag
description: A lightning strike: oscillator 2 synced and dropped three octaves by a fast mod envelope, a zap. Hit short notes. Strike harder to morph the zap longer; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Kortvag
description: Shortwave: a sine frequency-modulated by noise, the FM jumping on LFO 1's random steps and LFO 2 bending the pitch: a radio between stations. Hold notes. Push the wheel to morph the static heavier.

name: Meteor
description: A meteor: LFO 1's falling saw drops both oscillators five octaves over each bar, in time with the song. Hold a note. Push the wheel to morph the fall deeper.

name: Mistlur
description: A foghorn: a saw and a narrow pulse two octaves down, swelling through the distortion and a 24 dB low-pass, a slow waver from LFO 1. Hold a low note. Push the wheel to morph it brighter.

name: Rymdskepp
description: A spaceship: a sine ring-modulated by a square held at one high pitch whatever the key, both wobbling fast on LFO 1, thinned by the 24 dB high-pass. Hold notes. Push the wheel to morph the wobble faster and wider.

name: Uppvaknande
description: An awakening: oscillator 2 synced and lifted three octaves over six seconds by the mod envelope's slow attack, the filter opening with it, in unison pairs. Hold one note through a build. Push the wheel to morph the rise higher.

name: Brasa
description: Embers: a triangle and a pulse through the distortion, a reedy electric piano with a tremolo from LFO 2. Comp chords. Strike harder to morph in the pulse's bark, more level and a brighter filter; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Hovdans
description: A court dance: a narrow pulse and a saw an octave up through the 24 dB high-pass, plucked and ringing: a small harpsichord. Play a part in the middle. Push the wheel to morph the pulse wider, as a lute stop softens it.

name: Klockljung
description: Bell heather: an electric piano of a sine frequency-modulated by a triangle at its pitch, the FM struck by the mod envelope and dying away, a gentle tremolo from LFO 2. Comp chords in the middle. Strike harder to morph in the tine's bark and more level; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Lykta
description: A lantern: a saw and a pulse through a 24 dB low-pass with a soft envelope, each note to the other side. Comp chords. Strike harder to morph it brighter and louder; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Psalm
description: A small organ: a square with a square an octave up, gated, a faint vibrato. Play chords. Push the wheel to morph the upper square up to the twelfth, as a drawbar does.

name: Spinnrock
description: A spinning wheel: a narrow pulse through a resonant low-pass that snaps open and shut with the strike. Comp short chords. Strike harder to morph it louder and the pulse fuller; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Blixt
description: Lightning: oscillator 2 synced to oscillator 1 and swept down from high by the mod envelope at each strike, played legato with a short glide. Play a line up high. Strike harder to morph the sweep wider; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Dubbelnatur
description: Two natures in one: soft notes are a mellow triangle, hard ones a bright, resonant saw, the morph crossing the oscillators' balance and opening the filter with the strike. Play legato and vary the touch. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Ekolod
description: A sounding line: a pulse lead whose every note comes back five times on LFO 2's echo, in eighth notes, each softer and to the other side. Play short notes firmly, with room between them, as softer notes echo softer. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Glidflykt
description: Glide flight: two saws an octave apart, mono, gliding only between notes played legato (automatic portamento), through a resonant low-pass. Play a line low in the middle, slurring where it should glide. Strike harder to morph the glide longer; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Isbrytare
description: An icebreaker: a saw frequency-modulated by a triangle at its own pitch, a burst of FM from the mod envelope at each note, through the distortion and a resonant low-pass. Play a hard line low in the middle. Strike harder to morph in more FM; the wheel adds FM too.

name: Kulning
description: After the high herding call: a hollow pulse with an octave above it, mono with a little glide. Play a line up high and press into the long notes, which brings in the vibrato; the wheel deepens it too. Strike harder to morph it brighter.

name: Ljungeld
description: A heath fire: a saw and a pulse an octave down, driven through the distortion into a screaming resonant 24 dB low-pass. Play a mono line in the middle. Strike harder to morph the scream sharper; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Ringdans
description: A sine ring-modulated by a saw an octave up, the saw wobbling a little on LFO 1: a hollow, metallic line. Play legato up high. Push the wheel to morph the ring's partner up a fifth and both oscillators higher with it, into a clangorous dance.

name: Spelpipa
description: A folk pipe: a triangle with breath from oscillator 2's noise, soft at the start of each note. Play a melody up high; press into the long notes for vibrato. Strike harder to morph more breath in.

name: Valkyria
description: A square with oscillator 2 synced at its own pitch, so the sync is silent at rest: a plain, hollow lead. Push the wheel to morph oscillator 2 up two octaves and the filter open: the sync tears through, a Valkyrie riding in. Play legato up high.

name: Vargyl
description: A wolf's howl: four voices in unison on every key, saws an octave apart, spread wide and played legato, a short bite from the filter's envelope. Play a line high in the middle. Strike harder to morph it brighter; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Drivis
description: A pulse and a saw that drift like ice floes: the pulse's width wanders on LFO 1's smooth random and LFO 2 bends both slowly in pitch. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the drift wider.

name: Gryningsljus
description: Two saws whose 24 dB low-pass opens over three seconds, as dawn comes up, and stays open. Hold each chord and wait. Strike harder to morph the dawn quicker and brighter; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Isljus
description: A saw and a triangle an octave up through the 24 dB high-pass, which follows the keys and drifts slowly on LFO 2: a thin, high light with no body. Hold chords up high. Push the wheel to morph the body back in as the high-pass falls.

name: Korona
description: A sine frequency-modulated by a triangle an octave up, the FM wandering on LFO 1's smooth random: a shimmering corona round each note. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the FM deeper and the wandering faster.

name: Natthymn
description: A saw and a pulse through a resonant band-pass that sings like a vowel, a slow vibrato from LFO 2: a night hymn. Hold chords in the middle. Strike harder to morph the vowel open, from oo towards ah; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Nattvandring
description: Unison in poly: two detuned voices on every key, one to each side, each a saw with a saw an octave up, through a slowly opening low-pass. A wide, lush pad for long walks at night. Push the wheel to morph it brighter; the pedal opens the filter.

name: Polarvind
description: A saw with high noise beside it through a resonant band-pass that LFO 2 sweeps slowly: a pad with the polar wind in it. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the wind over the saw and the band-pass narrower.

name: Rimfrost
description: Two pulses, the second an octave up, their widths swept slowly by LFO 1: a glassy, shimmering pad. Strike harder to morph it brighter and quicker to speak; the wheel deepens the sweep.

name: Sammet
description: Velvet: a saw and a square an octave up. Play softly for a dark, slow swell; strike hard to morph it bright, resonant and quick. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Skymningsdis
description: A saw and a pulse an octave down through a resonant 24 dB low-pass that LFO 1's smooth random wanders over: dusk haze that never sits still. Hold long chords. Push the wheel to morph the drift faster, deeper and more resonant.

name: Sommarnatt
description: Two saws through the 24 dB low-pass, swelling in slowly, each new voice to the other side. Hold chords low in the middle. Push the wheel to morph the summer night into day: the cutoff, the resonance and the filter's envelope rise together and the attack quickens, the amber arcs on the face showing how far. The pedal opens the filter.

name: Tundra
description: Oscillator 2 synced to oscillator 1, its pitch swept slowly up and down by LFO 1: a hard, glassy pad whose overtones wander. Hold open chords. Strike harder to morph the sync higher; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Vinterhav
description: Two saws through the notch and low-pass, the notch swept up and down by LFO 1 like a slow phaser: a winter sea rolling under the chord. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the swell quicker and the notch deeper.

name: Droppe
description: A drop: two triangles an octave apart, plucked through a soft low-pass, each note to the other side. Pick through chords up high. Strike harder to morph it louder, brighter and ringing longer; the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Eko
description: An echo: a square pluck whose every note comes back six times in triplet eighths, in time with the song, each softer and to the other side. Play a few notes firmly, with room between them, as softer notes echo softer. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Gnista
description: A spark: oscillator 2 synced and swept down by the mod envelope at each pick, short and bright. Pick through chords up high. Strike harder to morph the sweep wider and the pick louder; the wheel raises the synced oscillator.

name: Harpa
description: A harp: a triangle and a saw an octave up. Pick softly for a dull, short note; strike hard to morph it bright, louder and ringing long. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Istapp
description: An icicle: a sine frequency-modulated by a triangle two octaves up, a burst of FM from the mod envelope at each pick. Pick through chords up high. Strike harder to morph the burst brighter and louder; the wheel adds FM.

name: Kantele
description: A plucked zither: a saw and a narrow pulse, bright at the pick, as bright as it is struck, and closing, ringing on. Pick through chords in the middle. Push the wheel to morph the strings ringing longer and brighter.

name: Regn
description: Rain: a saw with a little noise through a ringing band-pass that the envelope flicks open. Pick through chords up high. Strike harder to morph each drop brighter; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Ringla
description: A ring: a sine ring-modulated by a triangle two octaves up, the sine beside it, plucked short. Pick through chords up high. Push the wheel to morph the ring louder over the sine.

name: Ekon
description: Echoes: a short pulse for sequences, every note answered three times in eighth notes, in time with the song, softer and to the other side. Play a sixteenth-note line firmly, as softer notes echo softer. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Flimmer
description: A flicker: held chords chopped into sixteenths by LFO 2's tremolo, in time with the song. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the chop shallower and the chord brighter.

name: Karusell
description: A carousel: LFO 2's arpeggiator runs up the held chord over three octaves in sixteenths, in time with the song, each step to the other side. Hold chords in the middle. Push the wheel to morph the steps brighter and more resonant.

name: Klockverk
description: Clockwork: the arpeggiator ticks up the held chord in sixteenths through a ringing band-pass, and the strike sets its range: a soft chord stays in its octave, a hard one climbs four, the morph moving LFO 2's amount. Hold chords and vary the touch; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Maskin
description: A machine: a mono saw and pulse through a resonant 24 dB low-pass, LFO 1 sweeping the cutoff over each bar in time with the song. Play a sixteenth-note line. Strike harder to morph the envelope deeper; the wheel opens the filter.

name: Pendel
description: A pendulum: the arpeggiator swings up and down the held chord over four octaves in eighth notes, a triangle and a pulse a few cents apart. Hold chords low down. Push the wheel to morph the range in, down to two octaves.

name: Vattenfall
description: A waterfall: the arpeggiator runs down the held chord over two octaves in eighth-note triplets, each step a synced pluck swept by the mod envelope. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the sweep wider.

name: Fjord Strings
description: Two saws far apart in tune, a quick shiver of pitch from LFO 2 for the ensemble, each voice to the other side. Play string parts in the middle. Strike harder to morph the bow quicker and brighter; the wheel or the pedal brings in vibrato.

name: Spelman
description: A folk fiddler's solo line: a saw and a narrow pulse through a resonant low-pass, played legato with a little glide. Play a melody low down; press into a key to bring in its vibrato. Strike harder to morph the bow brighter.

name: Vinterljus
description: Two pulses an octave apart, their widths swept by LFO 1: a string machine in winter light. Hold chords and voice the top line. Push the wheel to morph the sweep quicker and the tone brighter.

name: Djupfryst
description: Deep frozen: a saw ring-modulated by a triangle held at one low pitch whatever the key, the triangle drifting on LFO 1's smooth random, through a resonant 24 dB low-pass. Hold low notes. Push the wheel to morph the filter open and the drift wider.

name: Evighetsmaskin
description: A perpetual motion machine: the arpeggiator's hold keeps the chord running after the keys are let go, up and down three octaves in sixteenths, until the next chord takes its place. Strike a chord and let go. Push the wheel to morph the steps brighter.

name: Gnistregn
description: A shower of sparks: a saw and a square through a ringing band-pass that LFO 1's random steps jump about in sixteenths, in time with the song. Hold chords. Push the wheel to morph the jumps wider.

name: Havsbrus
description: The sea's roar: noise through a low-pass, LFO 2 rolling its level in and out like waves and LFO 1 the filter with them. Hold a note or a chord. Push the wheel to morph the waves quicker.

name: Iskristall
description: Ice crystals: the arpeggiator picks notes of the chord at random over three octaves, in sixteenths, each a short FM chime, and its hold keeps them falling after the keys are let go. Strike a chord and let go. Push the wheel to morph the chimes brighter.

name: Polarljus
description: Polar light: a sine frequency-modulated a little off a twelfth, so it beats slowly, the FM wandering on LFO 1's smooth random. Hold one chord and let it move. Push the wheel to morph the shimmer deeper and quicker.

name: Trollskog
description: A troll forest: a sine ring-modulated a little over an octave up, the partner wandering on LFO 1's smooth random, every note answered by eight echoes. Play a few notes firmly, with room between them, as softer notes echo softer. The wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Vidd
description: Wide open country: two saws a fifth apart, in unison pairs spread wide, through the notch and low-pass that LFO 1 sweeps slowly, phasing. Hold one low note. Push the wheel to morph the swell deeper.

name: Vindkast
description: A gust: noise alone through a resonant band-pass that follows the keys, LFO 1's smooth random blowing it about, so each key whistles its own wind. Hold notes or chords. Push the wheel to morph the gusts stronger and the whistle sharper.
